# Checksums Verify Action

A composite GitHub Action for verifying SHA256 checksums of files against a pre-generated checksums file.

## Purpose

Verifies file integrity against a `SHA256SUMS.txt` file generated by the [checksums](.github/actions/checksums/README.md) action. Useful during the release phase for verifying artifacts before publishing.

## Input parameters (`inputs`)

| Parameter | Description | Required | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `artifacts_dir` | Directory with files to verify | Yes | — |
| `checksums_file` | Checksums filename | No | `SHA256SUMS.txt` |

## Usage example

```yaml
- name: Verify checksums
  uses: ai-warevo/<repo>/.github/actions/checksums-verify@72e62471355bf347d09c7e183af5fd33bf41fbaf
  with:
    artifacts_dir: release-artifacts/1.2.3
    checksums_file: SHA256SUMS.txt
```
